Apps

Once upon a time, I built native iOS apps.

I really wanted to learn native app development. Having a C background and having a bad experience with Android Dev, I got myself an iPhone 5, formed an LLC, and dove in on nights/weekends. In a perfect world I would have made millions! It’s been a lot of fun. Lately, I’ve been learning Swift
